message.content:
1: On he went (main clause)  
2: climbing blindly upward (participial clause)  
3: ever upward towards the high bare summit of what is known as Obatsuyama (participial clause)  
4: the mountain of the “abandoning of the aged” (appositive clause)  

5: The eyes of the old mother were not so dim (main clause)  
6: but that they noted the reckless hastening from one path to another (dependent clause)  
7: and her loving heart grew anxious (main clause)
